description: SYNCHRONIZED clause on a GROUP item - a COBOL-2023 introduction (§2023:E.3.2 item 6 / VCR row 43; before 2023 SYNCHRONIZED is permitted only on elementary items). Below 2023 it is REJECTED on BOTH axes through the canonical ConstructRegistry.Check funnel in DataBinder.UsageInheritanceWalk, like every other introduction. CA14 (owner-approved option (a), 2026-07-28) RETIRED the former accept-inert-under---permissive disposition: it was the sole site routing an introduction through the removed-severity seam, contradicting EditionSeverityPolicy.For(NotYetIntroduced)=>Error and the EditionContext.Permissive contract. --permissive is the migration mode for constructs an edition REMOVED; it has no meaning for one the targeted edition has not yet acquired, which no pre-existing program can legally contain.
citation: ISO §2023:E.3.2 item 6 / VCR row 43 (SYNCHRONIZED permitted on a group item, introduced 2023); §2023:13.18.55.3 SR1
